triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_bridge_action AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON atlas.action_queue FOR EACH ROW WHEN (new.status::text = 'pending'::text OR new.status::text = 'escalated'::text) EXECUTE FUNCTION atlas.bridge_push_action_to_lighthouse()
